summary: Woori Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval for a share exchange agreement to acquire TONGYANG Life Insurance as a wholly owned subsidiary. The board approved the exchange on April 24, 2026, and obtained board-level approval in lieu of a shareholders meeting on July 24, 2026. The expected effective date of the share exchange is August 11, 2026, with listing of new Woori shares on August 31, 2026. No deal terms (price, premium, advisor) are disclosed in this filing. This is a stock-for-stock acquisition resulting in full ownership. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder litigation risks.
